name: Salome Kikaleishvili
short: Film critic, journalist, and lecturer from Tbilisi, Georgia. She has extensive experience in media and cultural journalism and has served on FIPRESCI juries at international film festivals since 2007. She is currently an international voter for the Golden Globes and a member of the European Film Academy.
